description: Historical benchmark catalogue of extreme heatwaves, warm nights, and paired severe wind squall events across Indian climatic zones.

invariants.reference_standard: IMD gridded 0.5-degree daily maximum and minimum temperature, IMD heatwave archives, and ERA5 hourly 10m wind gusts.
invariants.anti_leakage: Temperature departures, observed peak values, and station gust records sealed behind 24h verification latency.

events.name: May 2015 Catastrophic Andhra Pradesh & Telangana Heatwave
events.synoptic_narrative: A persistent heat dome centered over Central and Peninsular India with continuous advection of dry, hot northwesterly winds from Sindh and Rajasthan, causing severe heatwave conditions and over 2,500 casualties in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

events.name: May 2016 Phalodi All-Time Record Heatwave
events.synoptic_narrative: Severe anticyclonic subsidence and intense solar insolation over Western Rajasthan culminated in India's highest ever recorded temperature of 51.0°C at Phalodi on May 19, 2016.

events.name: May-June 2019 Vidarbha & Churu Extended Heatwave Spell
events.synoptic_narrative: Prolonged multi-week heatwave across Central India and Rajasthan with 18 consecutive days above 45°C. Delayed onset of the southwest monsoon prevented maritime air ventilation.

events.name: March-April 2022 Earliest Recorded Intense Heatwave
events.synoptic_narrative: Record-breaking early heatwave driven by the near-total absence of active Western Disturbances in March 2022. Northwest India recorded its hottest March in 122 years of meteorological records.

events.name: April 2023 East India Humid Heatwave Spell
events.synoptic_narrative: Humid heatwave episode impacting West Bengal, Odisha, and Bihar with high wet-bulb temperatures and severe physiological heat stress.

events.name: May-June 2024 Record Northern Plains Extreme Heat Episode
events.synoptic_narrative: Unprecedented month-long continuous heatwave over Delhi NCR, Haryana, Rajasthan, and MP with automated weather stations recording peaks near 50°C and severe warm night conditions.

events.name: May 2021 Severe Pre-Monsoon Kalbaishakhi Squall Line
events.synoptic_narrative: Intense pre-monsoon convective squall line crossing from Rajasthan across Delhi and UP, generating gale-force gusts exceeding 27 m/s (99 km/h) and widespread structural disruption.
